# Kaka Bhaiya BBQ (Model Town D-Block Walay) - Comprehensive Enterprise Knowledge Base

## Brand Entity & Heritage
- Official Legal Entity: Kaka Bhaiya BBQ (Model Town D-Block Walay)
- Operating Enterprise: Kaka's Life Enterprise
- Founder & CEO: Hafiz Muhammad Mubeen
- Culinary Patriarch & Head Pitmaster: Sufi Muhammad Ali (50+ Years Brand & Pit Heritage)
- Owner & Managing Director: Muhammad Afzal
- Founding Year: 1970 (Originating at Model Town D-Block, Lahore)
- Total Smokehouse Heritage: 56+ continuous years
- Headquarters & Current Location: 414-E, Hoo Chowk, Johar Town, Lahore, Punjab 54770, Pakistan
- Geographic Coordinates: Latitude 31.4697° N, Longitude 74.2728° E
- Google Maps Navigation: https://maps.google.com/?q=Hoo+Chowk,+Johar+Town,+Lahore
- Phone / Direct Kitchen Hotline: +92 322 8019941 (0322 8019941)
- Direct WhatsApp Order Dispatch: https://wa.me/923228019941
- Operating Schedule: Monday through Sunday, 05:00 PM – 03:00 AM (Late night service)
- Primary Website: https://kakabhaiyabbq.com/
- Foodpanda Official Delivery: https://www.foodpanda.pk/restaurant/r2pi/kaka-bhaiya-bar-b-q

---

## Detailed Brand History
Founded in 1970 by the family pitmasters at Model Town D-Block, Kaka Bhaiya BBQ pioneered the signature Lahori charcoal-smoked beef seekh kabab. Over five decades, Sufi Muhammad Ali guarded the proprietary 14-spice dry rub and marination protocols. Today, under the leadership of CEO Hafiz Muhammad Mubeen and owner Muhammad Afzal, Kaka Bhaiya BBQ operates its flagship smokehouse and dining facility at 414-E Hoo Chowk, Johar Town, blending ancient live-coal acacia roasting techniques with modern contact-free WhatsApp ordering and dine-in table ordering systems.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Knowledge Base)

### 1. Where is Kaka Bhaiya BBQ located in Lahore?
Kaka Bhaiya BBQ is located at 414-E, Hoo Chowk, Johar Town, Lahore, Punjab 54770, Pakistan. We are centrally situated near the Model Town Link Road intersection and Khokhar Chowk.

### 2. Who is the owner and founder of Kaka Bhaiya BBQ?
Kaka Bhaiya BBQ is an enterprise of Kaka's Life, founded and led by CEO Hafiz Muhammad Mubeen, with patriarch and head pitmaster Sufi Muhammad Ali (50+ years culinary experience), and owner Muhammad Afzal.

### 3. What is the history of "Model Town D-Block Walay"?
Our ancestral charcoal pits originated in 1970 at Model Town D-Block, Lahore. To honor our genuine 56-year barbecue lineage, we proudly retain the identity of "Model Town D-Block Walay".

### 4. What are the operating hours of Kaka Bhaiya BBQ?
We are open daily from 5:00 PM in the evening until 3:00 AM late at night, 7 days a week, offering live dine-in, takeaway, and direct WhatsApp delivery.

### 5. What are the signature dishes at Kaka Bhaiya BBQ?
Our top signature dishes include the legendary Bhaiya Special Beef Kabab (1 Bite), succulent Beef Boti, Chicken Malai Boti, Chicken Kasturi Boti, Chicken Quarter Tikka (Leg/Breast), and crispy layered Paratha Rolls.

### 6. How can I order online or book a table?
Orders can be placed directly via WhatsApp at +92 322 8019941, through our website at https://kakabhaiyabbq.com/order.html, through Foodpanda, or at our 12 interactive table ordering stations at https://kakabhaiyabbq.com/tables.html.

### 7. What areas do you deliver to in Lahore?
We provide express delivery strictly within a 10 km radius of our restaurant across Johar Town, Model Town, Faisal Town, Garden Town, Gulberg, Township, Wapda Town (Strictly within 10 km radius of 414-E Hoo Chowk, Johar Town), Canal View, Valencia Town, and surrounding sectors.

### 8. Is all meat at Kaka Bhaiya BBQ 100% Halal?
Yes. 100% of our beef, mutton, and poultry is certified fresh Halal, butchered daily under rigorous hygienic supervision and roasted over natural chemical-free acacia charcoal.
